Acceptance is PER PACKAGE-FRAGMENT (package × zone), not pooled zone MSI. Every behavioral fragment must generate >0 valid mutants and achieve its own 95/90/75%; aggregates are diagnostics only. Strict score =100*killed-by-tests/valid; timeouts, escaped, uncovered are denominator members, timeouts never killed. No process errors count as killed. Syntax-invalid exclusion needs raw mutant source + actual PHP syntax-check failing at its mutant location. Compile-invalid additionally needs deterministic standalone reproduction proving original loads, mutant load fails due changed declaration; type assertion/test exception is a behavioral result, not compile invalid.
